name: Sydonic Permanent Facial Hair Removal Cream | For Men & Women | Smooth & Painless
description:
Enjoy salon-quality smoothness at home with Sydonic Permanent Hair Removal Cream. Specially formulated for men and women, it removes unwanted hair quickly and gently while keeping skin hydrated and soft. Suitable for the face, arms, legs, chest, underarms, and bikini area, this cream offers long-lasting smoothness without the pain of waxing or shaving. Affordable, safe, and easy to use, it’s your ultimate at-home hair removal solution.
Key Features
 Permanent hair removal with regular use
 Smooth & silky finish with long-lasting results
 Gentle on sensitive areas, painless application
 Enriched with hydrating, skin-friendly ingredients
 Suitable for men and women
 Works on face, arms, legs, chest, underarms & bikini area
 Fast-acting, safe, and affordable home solution
How to Use
 Apply evenly on the desired area
 Leave for the recommended time (do not exceed)
 Wipe off with a cloth, rinse thoroughly with water
 Moisturize if needed
Material
Skin-friendly hydrating ingredients, gentle hair removal agents
Safety Information
 Avoid eyes, cuts, and broken skin
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
 For external use only
 Keep away from children and pets
Package Includes
 1 × Sydonic Permanent Facial Hair Removal CreamSpecial Note:
 Shake well before each use
